parts.label: Part 2
parts.article:
Part 2. You will hear a railway station staff member introducing the activities that passengers can do while waiting for their trains.

First, you will have some time to look at questions eleven to fifteen.

Now listen carefully and answer questions eleven to fifteen.

Dear passengers, welcome to Fitchton Railway Station. I'm sorry to inform you that the train to London is delayed. It will take off two hours later at eleven forty-five AM. Please accept our apologies. In the meantime, allow me to introduce Fitchton Railway Station, so you can make the most of your time while waiting for the train.

The main entrance of the station is on Fitchton Road. If you want to take a bike ride around here, walk down Fitchton Road and pass the taxi stop. You can find a bike rack on the right.

But if you just want to stay in the station, it's okay. You can find a luggage locker when you enter the station. It's on the left. You can put your luggage there. If you don't feel very well or you need to buy some medicine, there's a chemist in the farthest corner of the station opposite to the cafe,

and you can have a cup of coffee at the cafe if you want. The big area near the cafe is the waiting room, where you can have a seat and relax. If you want to use the toilet, make a left when you enter the station, then turn right. Go straight until you walk past platform two. It's right there at the end. The news agency is in the southeast corner of the station.

Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions sixteen to twenty.

Now listen and answer questions sixteen to twenty.

If you don't want to stay in the station, you can also have a look around the station, but make sure to get back in time for the train. I'm sure you don't want to miss it. The Fitchton College is within walking distance from the station. The view is quite good there. The town library is also just down the road if you want to read. Oh, there's also an art exhibition at the moment. You can go and check it out. The store across the street opens throughout the day, and you can find all kinds of stuff there. You don't want to buy any gifts for your friends there, though. Most items will be difficult to carry on a bike. But our local food is something I recommend. It would be too late if you want them once you are on the train. You can buy some at the Foodies shop, which is right next to the station.

If you're looking for anything to wear during the trip, you'd better go to the department store, but I'm afraid there isn't enough time for that.

You can send some postcards with local pictures on them to your friends and family. You can buy them in the community college, which is near the museum.

The old cinema behind the museum cannot compete against the new theater in the shopping center, so the current owner plans to make it an accommodation block instead.

In the back of the train station, you can see a statue of Richard Travolt, a local government minister who is famous for completing a lot of construction projects in our city. Again, I'd like to remind you the train will leave at eleven forty-five. Please get back in time, and I hope you enjoy your time at Fitchton.

That's the end of Section two. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

analyses.content: 录音明确提示从车站主入口（main entrance）出发，沿着Fitchton Road走，经过出租车站（taxi stop）后在右侧就能找到自行车架。
你可能会因为没有第一时间找准“主入口”和“Fitchton Road”这两个路线起点，导致一开始就跟丢了地图的行进方向。
The main entrance of the station is on Fitchton Road. If you want to take a bike ride around here, walk down Fitchton Road and pass the taxi stop. You can find a bike rack on the right.
录音明确指出，当你一进车站（when you enter the station），在左手边就能看到行李储物柜。
你可能会忽略“一进站”这个极其关键的起始参照点，导致眼睛在地图内部区域盲目寻找。
But if you just want to stay in the station, it's okay. You can find a luggage locker when you enter the station. It's on the left. You can put your luggage there.
录音说明药店在车站最远的角落里，并且明确指出在咖啡馆（cafe）的正对面。
你可能只听到了“最远的角落”就急着找边缘的字母，而忽略了“咖啡馆对面”这个能帮你一锤定音的核心参照物。
If you don't feel very well or you need to buy some medicine, there's a chemist in the farthest corner of the station opposite to the cafe,
录音给出的去厕所路线是：进站后先左转再右转，直走经过二号站台（platform two），走到尽头就是。
这里的路线包含了连续的转向指令和参照物，你很容易在密集的路线描述中跟错某一个转弯方向而彻底迷路。
If you want to use the toilet, make a left when you enter the station, then turn right. Go straight until you walk past platform two. It's right there at the end.
录音非常直接地指出了新闻报刊亭位于整个车站的东南角（southeast corner）。
如果你对“东南西北”这种方位词反应不够快，或者做题前没留意地图上的方向标，就很容易选到其他的角落。
The news agency is in the southeast corner of the station.

groups.description: The map below has nine labels A-I. Choose the correct label.

questions.question: Where could the passengers see the exhibition?

analyses.content: 录音先提到了镇图书馆（town library），接着马上补充说那里现在正有一个艺术展可以去看看。
录音里接连出现了学院和车站等干扰地点，你可能会因为没跟上句意连贯性，没有把展览和紧挨着提到的“图书馆”绑定在一起。
The town library is also just down the road if you want to read. Oh, there's also an art exhibition at the moment. You can go and check it out.

questions.question: What is the best gift for passengers to buy and bring home?

analyses.content: 录音直接否定了去商店买其他礼物（因为骑车不好拿），转而明确推荐你买当地美食（local food）作为礼物。
你可能会在听到“buy any gifts”时就急着看选项，从而完美错过了后面真正的“否定干扰”和“推荐重点”。

The store across the street opens throughout the day, and you can find all kinds of stuff there. You don't want to buy any gifts for your friends there, though. Most items would be difficult to carry on a bike. But our local food is something I recommend. It would be too late if you want them once you are on the train. You can buy some at the Foodies shop, which is right next to the station.

questions.question: Where can passengers buy souvenir postcards?

analyses.content: 录音非常清楚地说明，你可以在社区学院（community college）里买到明信片。
你极其容易听到“near the museum”就落入陷阱去选博物馆选项，而没仔细听出博物馆仅仅是用来修饰学院方位的参照物。
You can send some postcards with local pictures on them to your friends and family. You can buy them in the community college, which is near the museum.

questions.question: What will the old cinema be converted to?

analyses.content: 录音提到因为老电影院竞争不过新剧院，现任老板计划将其改建为住宿区（accommodation block），直接对应选项中的住房区域。
你可能会因为没仔细看题，直接抓取了录音中用来做背景铺垫的“新剧院”或“购物中心”等干扰词而选错。
The old cinema behind the museum cannot compete against the new theater in the shopping center, so the current owner plans to make it an accommodation block instead.

questions.question: Who is the statue in the train station modeled after?

analyses.content: 录音介绍这座雕像的原型是当地的一位政府部长（government minister），这完美对应了选项中的政治家。
你很容易因为听到后面补充说明他负责了很多“建筑项目（construction projects）”，就依靠主观猜测掉进了“工程师”的陷阱。
In the back of the train station, you can see a statue of Richard Travolt, a local government minister who is famous for completing a lot of construction projects in our city.
